newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Heidelberger to buy Bulgaria cement plants.
newsitem.headline: Heidelberger to buy Bulgaria cement plants.

text.p: Germany's Heidelberger Zement AG has bid successfully to buy stakes in Bulgaria's Zlatna Panega and Granitoid-Pernik cement plants for a total of $27.5 million, the construction minister said on Thursday.
"Heidelberger Zement was chosen as a potential buyer of a 51 percent stake in Zlatna Panega and 75 percent of Granitoid for a total of $27.5 million," Nikola Karadimov told reporters.
The ministry will now negotiate details to finalise the deal. Two other foreign companies placed bids for Zlatna Panega plant.

Under the terms of the agreement, the new owner has to invest a total of $25 million in Zlatna Panega of which $15 million must be invested in the next three years under the condition that they would not be invested in a capital rise.
The new owner has also to increase Zlatna Panega's annual output to 550,000 tonnes of cement from 300,000 tonnes.

Heidelberger was chosen among three bidders to buy 75 percent of Granitoid for $1.5 million, Karadimov said. The buyer must invest $3 million in technical equipment for the Pernik plant. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
